summary: Blocks em dashes, en dashes, and `' -- '` used as a dash in file writes and shell commands.
doc: This hook denies a Write, Edit, MultiEdit, NotebookEdit, or Bash call when its new text contains an em dash (U+2014), en dash (U+2013), horizontal bar (U+2015), minus sign (U+2212), escaped spelling such as `\u2014` or `—`, or `' -- '` used as a dash in a prose file. Models use the em dash more often than people do, and readers notice it. The hook scans only new text, so existing files and reads remain unaffected. A grep for the character or a sed that removes it is allowed. To quote a source that contains a dash, put it in a fenced code block, an inline backtick span, or a '>' blockquote.
